entries.description: pre_tool refuses short review flags, a GraphQL mutation, and non-GET or token-bearing calls to api.github.com.
Review comments, a read-only GraphQL query, a token-free GET, and gh pr view stay allowed.
The enforce README, guide step 10, and the failure-modes doc name the pattern-matching limit and the token rule.
Guide step 5 shows the spec tree, a PRD excerpt, acceptance JSON that parses, and --plan.
Guide step 13 shows the interview, a failing then passing node --test run, and an ESC entry that parses.
The guide command-runner test still passes after the new guide commands.
